dev: रुको! अभी साँस रोको... सिर्फ़ दस सेकंड।
roman: Ruko! Abhi saans roko... sirf 10 second.
on_screen: Black flash, then a huge 'RUKO!' slams in with a punch-in, and 'SAANS ROKO' appears under it. A 10-second countdown ring pops in at the top corner (off the face) on '10 second' and starts at 10. SFX: whoosh, then a soft clock tick under the countdown.

dev: घुटन क्यों होगी... ए, ऑक्सीजन कम, या बी, सीओटू ज़्यादा?
roman: Ghutan kyun hogi... A, oxygen kam, ya B, CO2 zyada?
on_screen: Two option cards pop in on their own words: 'A: Oxygen kam' (blue) and 'B: CO2 zyada' (orange). The countdown keeps ticking in the corner.
A lock icon snaps over both cards with the tag 'JAWAB END MEIN'. Countdown is at about 7.

dev: हल्की बेचैनी? बॉडी सीओटू बनाती रहती है... पर बाहर का रास्ता बंद!
roman: Halki bechaini? Body CO2 banati rehti hai... par bahar ka raasta band!
on_screen: Body silhouette: cells keep puffing out grey CO2 bubbles. A gate slams shut on the windpipe, labelled 'BAND'. The countdown hits 0 on 'band' with a soft buzzer. Small text at 0: 'ab saans le lo', plus an exhale whoosh (on screen only).

dev: सीओटू पानी से मिलकर ब्लड को थोड़ा एसिडिक बनाता है।
roman: CO2 paani se milkar blood ko thoda acidic banata hai.
on_screen: Close-up of a blood vessel filling with CO2 dots and a 'Blood CO2' meter climbing. An equation card pops in: 'CO2 + H2O -> carbonic acid' (optional soda-fizz icon and SFX). A pH needle moves only slightly down from 7.4, labelled 'thoda acidic'.
Mid-video re-hook: the frame freezes and a giant 'KAUN?' hits with a zoom punch-in and a riser SFX.

dev: तुम्हारा ब्रेनस्टेम! इसके सेंसर्स ब्रेन के आसपास एसिड चेक करते हैं।
roman: Tumhara brainstem! Iske sensors brain ke aaspaas acid check karte hain.
on_screen: Brain cutaway with the brainstem (medulla) glowing. Label: 'Brainstem sensors (central chemoreceptors)'. Small sensor pings in the fluid around the brain, with a ping SFX.

dev: फिर सिग्नल ब्रीदिंग सेंटर को... डायफ्राम को ऑर्डर, साँस लो!
roman: Phir signal breathing centre ko... diaphragm ko order, saans lo!
on_screen: Arrow chain animates: Sensors -> Breathing centre -> Diaphragm (a dome muscle under the lungs that pulses and contracts). SFX: electric zap. 'SAANS LO!' slams in with a punch-in.

dev: इसीलिए साँस रोकना मुश्किल लगा... यही थी वो बेचैनी!
roman: Isiliye saans rokna mushkil laga... yahi thi woh bechaini!
on_screen: Quick replay of the opening countdown ring next to a rising bar: 'CO2 badha -> urge badha'. Text: 'YAHI THI WOH BECHAINI'.
The A/B cards return. Card B lights up green with a tick and scales up; card A dims but is not crossed out. SFX: correct-answer ding.

dev: मतलब घुटन का मेन ट्रिगर ऑक्सीजन की कमी नहीं, बल्कि बढ़ता हुआ सीओटू है।
roman: Matlab ghutan ka main trigger oxygen ki kami nahi, balki badhta hua CO2 hai.
on_screen: Big headline: 'MAIN TRIGGER = BADHTA CO2'. Small footnote under it: 'Oxygen ka bhi role hai (carotid body), par main trigger CO2'.

dev: ध्यान रहे, तेज़ साँसें लेकर, या पानी में, साँस रोकने की प्रैक्टिस कभी नहीं।
roman: Dhyan rahe, tez saansein lekar, ya paani mein, saans rokne ki practice kabhi nahi.
on_screen: Calm yellow safety card (not alarming red) with two crossed-out icons: 'Pehle tez/gehri saansein (hyperventilation) + breath-hold: NAHI' and 'Paani mein breath-hold practice: NAHI'. The music dips slightly.

dev: बेहोशी बिना वॉर्निंग आ सकती है।
roman: Behoshi bina warning aa sakti hai.
on_screen: Short, gentle dim and blur of the picture, with the text 'Blackout bina warning ke'.

dev: तुमने ए सोचा या बी? कमेंट करो!
roman: Tumne A socha ya B? Comment karo!
on_screen: Both A/B cards with a comment box typing 'A ya B?'. Captions stop here. Then dip to black into the Science Unseen Hindi logo end card (fade-in, slow push-in) while the music fades out.
